name: Solenne Mirrorweave Bioluminescent Gala Gown
description:
Solenne's flagship gala gown is among the most recognized formal garments produced in GLMZ, which is partly by design — it is meant to be seen and remembered. The foundation fabric is a proprietary mirrorweave silk-analog that shifts between deep iridescence and near-opacity depending on viewing angle and ambient light, creating the impression that the gown is made of something between water and metal. The hem is seeded with bioluminescent thread — a TESSERA-licensed biological compound woven directly into the fabric — that activates in low light and pulses with a slow, steady rhythm calibrated to approximate a resting heartbeat. The effect in a darkened gala space is genuinely arresting.

The gown is fully custom-fitted via biometric scan and accommodates virtually any geneware modification — tail vents, wing slits, horn clearance at the neckline, and fur-friendly interior lining are all available as standard specifications. BCI-responsive color modulation allows the iridescent base to shift through a curated palette at the wearer's thought. A single gown of this type costs more than a Tier 2 resident earns in a year. This is not incidental to its design.
cultural_context: The Solenne mirrorweave gown is a Spire status object. Being seen in one at a gala communicates wealth, access, and a certain kind of confidence. The bioluminescent hem is distinctive enough that observers remember it specifically. Some wearers find that uncomfortable. Most do not.
story_hooks: A character wearing this gown to a public-facing Spire event is photographed extensively. The images circulate on Ringo media feeds. Someone on the Shelf recognizes the person wearing it as someone who grew up three doors down from them.
The BCI color modulation begins responding to emotional states the wearer did not intend to display. The gown is, in a roomful of observers, reading the wearer more accurately than they'd like.
A Solenne gown appears at a Tier 2 secondhand market — damaged, the bioluminescent hem dark. Someone spent Φ5800 on this and it ended up here. The question of how is the beginning of something.

physical_description.visual_profile: A floor-length formal gown with an ethereal, fluid silhouette that seems to shift between solid and translucent depending on angle and light. The upper body is fitted and elegant, flowing into a dramatic skirt that moves like liquid mercury. The hem glows with a soft, rhythmic bioluminescent pulse that creates an almost living quality to the garment.
physical_description.fit: Tailored to the individual wearer via biometric scan — form-fitting through the bodice and torso, then flowing and voluminous through the skirt. Fully customizable to accommodate geneware modifications (tail vents, wing slits, horn clearance, fur-friendly lining).
physical_description.primary_material: Proprietary mirrorweave silk-analog (Solenne Atelier exclusive) with integrated TESSERA-licensed bioluminescent thread throughout the hem and lower panels
physical_description.texture: Smooth, fluid drape with an almost liquid quality to the touch. The mirrorweave surface is slightly cool and has a subtle sheen that catches light unpredictably. The bioluminescent hem threads create fine linear texture details.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep iridescent base that shifts between jewel tones — sapphire, violet, emerald, and silver — depending on viewing angle and ambient light. The hem glows in soft cyan-white bioluminescence that pulses like a heartbeat.
physical_description.closures: Invisible magnetic seam closures along the side/back, seamlessly integrated into the garment design for an unbroken silhouette
distinctive_features: Mirrorweave fabric that creates a shimmering, angle-dependent iridescence
Bioluminescent hem with biological thread pulsing at resting heartbeat rhythm (approximately 60 bpm)
BCI-responsive color modulation allowing real-time iridescent palette shifts via neural interface
Custom biometric tailoring for individual body profile
Geneware accommodation features (tail vents, wing slits, horn clearance, fur-compatible lining) as standard options
Solenne Atelier signature invisible branding at interior neckline
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury — extreme wealth signal. Cost equivalent to 12+ months of Tier 2 annual earnings
physical_description.cultural_context: Spire status object worn at elite corporate galas and high-society events. Communicates wealth, access to exclusive biotech fabrication, neural augmentation capability, and confident social positioning. The distinctive bioluminescent signature makes the wearer immediately recognizable and memorable — a feature intentional to Solenne's design philosophy.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and meticulously maintained, though the bioluminescent thread may show subtle color variation with age. Each garment is typically worn only to curated events.

image_prompt: A striking cyberpunk gala gown on a high-fashion model with subtle augmentation visible (neural port, iridescent eyes, or minimalist chrome detailing). The mirrorweave fabric ripples with deep iridescent blues, violets, and silvers as it catches moody theatrical lighting. The hem pulses with soft cyan-white bioluminescence in a darkened setting, creating a heartbeat-rhythm glow that trails along the floor. Shot in an upscale dystopian venue — all dark marble and neon accent lighting. Model's posture is confident and commanding. Close detail shot of the luminous hem showing the living quality of the bioluminescent thread. Cinematic, otherworldly, dripping with Tier 1 wealth and neural-integrated luxury --ar 2:3 --v 6
